# Phase 3 Habits Checklist: QuickFlow Personal Productivity Workspace

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality check for the Phase 3 (User Story 2 - Track recurring habits) acceptance criteria AS1-AS7 and FR-007..FR-011 used by loop-3 testing: habit fields and validation, completion recording and duplicates, undo, streak and completion-rate rules, deactivate/remove, API errors and UX states.
**Created**: 2026-10-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied (non-interactive): depth Standard, audience Reviewer (testing loop), focus US2 acceptance criteria + validation/API errors + streak/rate rules + UX states.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is it specified whether habit name whitespace is trimmed before the 1-150 length rule is applied? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §US2 AS1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the habit fields that may be changed on update (name, description, frequency) listed, and is the effect of a frequency change on existing completions and stats specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 Is it specified whether a completion may be recorded for a date other than today (past dates, future dates, dates before the habit's creation)? [Gap, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK004 Is it specified whether an inactive habit can be completed or uncompleted? [Gap, Spec §US2 AS6]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the feedback the user gets when a duplicate completion is attempted ("sees it is already done") specified in content and form? [Completeness, Spec §US2 AS3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the default list order and the active/inactive grouping of habits on the page specified? [Gap, Spec §US2 AS1, §AS6]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "current streak" defined unambiguously for a period that is not yet done (counting from the previous period) and for a Weekly habit with several completions in one week? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011, §US2 AS5]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the completion-rate formula (numerator, denominator, rounding, inclusion of the current period) specified for both Daily (30 days) and Weekly (12 weeks)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "counted from the habit's creation if younger" defined for Weekly habits (creation week vs creation day)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "toggle it off" for a Weekly habit done earlier in the week but not today defined (which record is removed, what the toggle shows)? [Clarity, Spec §US2 AS4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "today" tied to the user's local time zone for completion dates and the ISO week boundary? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions, Edge Cases "Time zone"]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK012 Are AS4 ("completion record for the current period is removed") and FR-010 ("undo today's completion") consistent for Weekly habits? [Consistency, Spec §US2 AS4, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the error status codes for duplicate completion, unknown habit, missing completion and invalid date consistent with the shared problem+json error format? [Consistency, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the exclusion of deactivated habits consistent between the Habits page, dashboard metrics and plan builder? [Consistency, Spec §US2 AS6, §US4 AS1, Edge Cases]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Can "the card shows it done for the current period" be objectively verified for Daily and Weekly habits? [Measurability, Spec §US2 AS2]
- [ ] CHK016 Can the streak and completion rate shown on a card be verified against a defined set of completion dates? [Measurability, Spec §US2 AS5]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for concurrent or rapid double completion of the same habit and date? [Coverage, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK018 Are recovery requirements defined when a completion or deactivate request fails after the UI has already changed? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is removal confirmation and the message suggesting deactivation (to keep history) specified? [Coverage, Spec §US2 AS6, §FR-031]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are week-boundary cases (Sunday to Monday, year end ISO week 52/53/1) addressed for Weekly streaks? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Are long names (150 chars) and long descriptions (2,000 chars) display rules (truncation, full text access) specified for the card? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are accessibility requirements (toggle state announced, keyboard operation, focus return after dialogs) specified for the habit card and form? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK023 Are animation requirements for completion and streak changes bounded by reduced-motion preferences? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK024 Is the assumption that a habit completion has no time-of-day (date only) documented and consistent with "created-at" on the completion? [Assumption, Spec §FR-009]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
